basics.name: Xudong Zhu
basics.summary: My research examines how large language models represent concepts and how these representations evolve during generation and training. I focus on the linear structure of these representations and its role in understanding and steering model behavior, as well as how different training methods, such as SFT and RL, reshape these learned representations.

highlights.title: Concept representations
highlights.description: Study how LLMs represent concepts, focusing on their linear structure, bidirectional features, and connections to model interpretability and behavioral control.

highlights.title: Generation dynamics
highlights.description: Study how concept representations evolve during generation and how steering propagates their influence on subsequent model behavior.

highlights.title: Training dynamics
highlights.description: Study how training methods such as SFT and RL reshape concept representations, their linear structure, and their influence on behavior over the course of training.
